sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for procuring essential equipment required for silkworm rearing.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Agriculture,Rural & Environment; Sector: Financial assistance

**Detailed Description:** The “Keetpalan Upkaran” scheme by the Sericulture Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for procuring essential equipment required for silkworm rearing.

**Benefits / Assistance:** - An assistance of ₹40,000 (80:10:10) is provided to selected beneficiaries for purchasing necessary equipment for insect farming. - Out of this amount, 10% is to be spent by the beneficiary themselves to establish a leaf chamber, while other insect farming materials are provided by the department.

**Application Process:** - Interested beneficiaries are selected through promotional meetings/trainings organized by representatives of cooperative societies associated with the block centers / sericulture self-help groups and center/range in the field. - Upon receiving a cluster proposal for a specific area, a specialist committee conducts a ground inspection to determine whether the area is suitable for mulberry plantation/activities. - Following the recommendation of the ground inspection, the technical support of departmental personnel is provided for mulberry planting and other work plans in accordance with the guidelines. - To prepare the P.I.S. for the selected beneficiaries, voter ID/ration card, bank account details, and land-related documents of the area where they wish to plant trees are collected. - The establishment of the leaf chamber is done by the farmers, and other pest rearing materials are provided by the department. Under the Silk Samagra scheme, there is a provision for training farmers, in which all farmers selected in the cluster are trained in tree planting/pest rearing, etc. Those beneficiaries who are not selected under the scheme are given training as mentioned above.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Department Of Sericulture
**Tags:** Financial Assistance, Farmer, Equipment, Silkworm, Rearing
